name: questionnaire
title: Questionnaire
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Questionnaire (one question at a time, the kind an AI agent asks). The whole form is a case (3px ink line, tone shadow). Progress reads “Question 2 of 4” in lettering beside a 2px ink rail filled with speed lines that moves in steps. Each question pops in over three frames; titles are lettering, descriptions the reading face. Each choice is a choice card: a 2px ink frame whose line thickens on hover, with the ink / paper / ink focus ring around the row; checked, a 6px ink bar grows down its start edge and the indicator fills with ink (radio = a diamond with a paper dot, checkbox = a square with a brush check that draws itself). Shortcuts are key caps. The free-text input is the kit Input. Errors: accent line, a “!” mark and one shake. Previous / Skip are outline buttons, Next / Submit ink buttons, all with the impact on click. Disabled choices: dashed line and tone frame, label on paper.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/questionnaire". It wraps your own components/ui/questionnaire (built on @shadcn/react), so it works with the Radix and Base UI versions of shadcn alike. The progress rail reads the aria values of the progress element, so it follows any number of questions.

meta.tagline: One question at a time, in an inked case with a running progress rail.
meta.usage:
import {
  Questionnaire, QuestionnaireActions, QuestionnaireChoice, QuestionnaireChoices, QuestionnaireError,
  QuestionnaireItem, QuestionnaireNext, QuestionnairePrevious, QuestionnaireProgress, QuestionnaireSubmit, QuestionnaireTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/manga/questionnaire"

<Questionnaire shortcuts="letters" onSubmit={save}>
  <QuestionnaireProgress />
  <QuestionnaireItem name="genre" required>
    <QuestionnaireTitle>Which genre?</QuestionnaireTitle>
    <QuestionnaireChoices>
      <QuestionnaireChoice value="action">Action</QuestionnaireChoice>
      <QuestionnaireChoice value="romance">Romance</QuestionnaireChoice>
    </QuestionnaireChoices>
    <QuestionnaireError />
  </QuestionnaireItem>
  <QuestionnaireActions>
    <QuestionnairePrevious />
    <QuestionnaireNext />
    <QuestionnaireSubmit />
  </QuestionnaireActions>
</Questionnaire>

props.name: shortcuts
props.description: On Questionnaire: shows a key cap on each choice and picks it on key press.

props.name: multiple
props.description: On QuestionnaireItem: square checkboxes instead of radio diamonds.

props.name: required / invalid
props.description: On QuestionnaireItem: required hides Skip; invalid shows the error look and QuestionnaireError.

props.name: disabled / defaultChecked
props.description: On QuestionnaireChoice: the dashed disabled card / a pre-checked choice.

props.name: variant / size
props.description: On Previous, Skip, Next, Submit: drawn with the kit button look (outline for Previous / Skip, ink for Next / Submit by default).
